title: Aa ali Asghar
body:
Aa ali Asghar
tujhko jo paaun ay mere asghar, jhoola jhulaun aa mere asghar
jhoola jhulaun lori sunaun, doodh pilaun aa mere asghar
mere mujahid mere sipahi, khatm huvi maidaan may ladaai
ghar ko sidharo maa ko pukaro, mai chain paaun aa mere asghar
<<MINI>>
tujhko jo paaun....
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aa rahi hai masoom baatein, din may sukun hai bechain raate
ji na sakungi roti rahungi, aansu bahao aa mere asghar
<<MINI>>
tujhko jo paaun....
<<DIVIDER>>
pooch rahi hai bali sakina, kyon nahi aaya laut ke bhaiya
tu hi batade maidan se aake, mai kya bataun aa mere asghar
<<MINI>>
tujhko jo paaun....
<<DIVIDER>>
pehre huve hai shaam ke saaye, ab to parinde bhi laut aaye
mai ro rahi hoo jaan kho rahi hoo, tujko sulaaun aa mere asghar
<<MINI>>
tujhko jo paaun....
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi gala aur pyaas ki shiddat, hoti to hogi maa ki zuroorat
tu jo pukare dil ke sahare, mai daudi aaun aa mere asghar
<<MINI>>
tujhko jo paaun....
<<DIVIDER>>
mehsoos mujko ye ho raha hai, jaise ke jhoola bhi ro raha hai
ay mere beta ye rota jhoola, kaise Jhulaaun aa mere asghar
<<MINI>>
tujhko jo paaun....
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas bujhaane nehr kanare, jab se gaye ho ay mere pyare
dar sa laga hai dil doobta hai, palkein bichaaun aa mere asghar
maktal se aaye aise khabar
makhtal se aayi kaisi khabar hai, kurta lahoo se sab tera tar hai
teer laga hai zakhmi gala hai, mai mar na jaaun aa mere asghar
<<MINI>>
tujhko jo paaun....
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan-o-sarwar banu ke lab par, ek sada thi ay mere asghar
sooni hai jungal hai gham ka badal tujko chupaun aa mere asghar
<<MINI>>
tujhko jo paaun....
